summary.headline: Valens’s Chronology and Star Calculations
summary.text: Discussion of Valens’s astrological star-position calculations for nativities, arguing from his use of Trajanic and Hadrianic dates that he lived under the Antonines. A chronological list compares imperial-era dates from Marcian, Vatican, and Hamburg codices, with corrections to Valens’s year numerals and Alexandrian calendar conversions.
